title: Vehicle ready for pickup
description: Tell customers their car is ready after service, with total and pickup hours. Utility WhatsApp template for workshops. Copy it and adapt the brand.
notes: Include the final amount and closing time; this saves calls. Don't promote extra services in the text.

body.text: Good news, {{first_name}}! Your {{vehicle}} is ready for pickup. Total: *{{total}}*. We are open until {{closing}} today.
